title: Hydropower & Tidal Energy
painPoint: Hydro and tidal turbine generators run submerged or in high-humidity environments, where direct-drive permanent magnet rotors must deliver high torque at low speed without a gearbox for decades. Designers face severe constraints: seawater corrosion, cavitation, and biofouling, plus fluctuating loads that can demagnetize unstable magnets. Producing rated flux at large diameters demands uniform, high-grade blocks and arc segments, while minimizing eddy-current losses and rotor weight. Temperature excursions and salt spray degrade coatings, and inconsistent magnetic properties between batches cause balancing problems and reduced generator efficiency across the asset lifetime.
youjiuSolution: YOUJIU supplies high-performance NdFeB magnets engineered for hydro and tidal generators, including N42, N48, N52 and 35UH grades with tailored temperature ratings up to 180°C. We manufacture large blocks and precision arc segments with tight dimensional tolerances and consistent magnetic flux, enabling efficient direct-drive and rim-drive designs. Multi-layer NiCuNi plus epoxy or marine-grade coatings withstand salt spray and humid service. Our engineering team helps select the right grade and coating for your duty cycle, then validates flux and demagnetization margins before shipping.
